== Summary ==
Identified: [[Dan Tartaglione]] (far right, distinctive cyan-and-black plaid shirt; same shirt as [[:File:2024 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] and [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]). Remaining: the standing player with receding hair, long back hair, and a black sleeveless tank top (same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship Slack 20 September 02.jpg]]); the player in a black shirt and glasses in the foreground; the standing player in a camo cap, grey tee, and maroon shorts (same person as the far end of [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]); the player with long hair in a peach shirt; the bald player in a white tee; and other unlabeled faces.

The tournament room at Zu den Vier Winden between games.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Dan Tartaglione]] (far right, distinctive cyan-and-black plaid shirt; same shirt as [[:File:2024 World Championship Top 8.jpg]] and [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]). Remaining: the standing player with receding hair, long back hair, and a black sleeveless tank top (same person as in [[:File:2024 World Championship Slack 20 September 02.jpg]]); the player in a black shirt and glasses in the foreground; the standing player in a camo cap, grey tee, and maroon shorts (same person as the far end of [[:File:2024 World Championship group photo.jpg]]); the player with long hair in a peach shirt; the bald player in a white tee; and other unlabeled faces.
